games.title: Deus Ex
games.notes: Plays the single-player campaign in co-op. The ModDB page now says the mod was deleted, but the last public build is dated 2019-06-04 on the author's build server and a 2025-2026 Steam guide still recommends it. Described as buggy.

games.title: Deus Ex
games.notes: Dockerized dedicated server for the HX co-op mod. MIT licensed, release 1.1.0 from 2024-04, last push 2024-11.

games.title: Deus Ex
games.notes: Single-player missions with friends, where players take the role of NPCs who help the protagonist. Only a beta was released and the page says development ended.

games.title: Deus Ex
games.notes: Cooperative modification repository, last pushed 2014-08. No readme details were checked, so scope is unknown.

games.title: System Shock 2
games.notes: The 1999 game ships a built-in co-op mode that SS2Tool unlocks via a Game features checkbox. Difficulty is locked to hard, and fan netcode fixes exist (ss2_netfixes, Dan's Multiplayer Gameplay Tweaks) but netcode is hard to improve without source.

games.title: System Shock 2
games.notes: Nightdive's June 2025 remaster advertises 4-player co-op with PC and console cross-play. A Steam thread says one store page dropped co-op wording and a PartyDeck issue claims LAN co-op, so confirm in-game.

games.title: Thief II: The Metal Age
games.notes: Restores Thief 2's unused multiplayer code since 2007, with most original missions reported playable (v2.15). Steam threads say it only works on the OldDark v1.18 build and needs port forwarding or LAN. A costume add-on (vfig/t2mpfun) was last pushed 2024-11.

games.title: Thief II: The Metal Age
games.notes: NewDark's own multiplayer beta (Thief2MP.exe, since 1.27; use 1.29 from 2026-09) lets 2-3 players play the original missions together. T2MPFix (MIT) is a small DLL that every player drops into the game folder. It has four fixes, each of which can be turned off in T2MPFix.ini: (1) smooth movement: other players no longer lag behind, get stuck on doorways, float or jump around (checked in automated tests with real game instances); (2) steering bug: players who don't have T2MPFix no longer trail behind; (3) player limit: up to 8 players, and the last one to join no longer kicks others out (stock: a 4th player kicks two); (4) environmental damage: hazards such as lava hurt again.

games.title: Half-Life
games.notes: Free standalone Steam version of the long-running co-op mod, with online and LAN co-op. Steam shows 93 percent positive of 15,554 reviews. The original site still lists an old 2.x download, so use Steam.

games.title: Half-Life 2
games.notes: Free Steam mod for playing the HL2, Lost Coast and Episode campaigns (and other Source singleplayer mods) cooperatively. Steam shows 89 percent positive of 5,541 reviews. Player cap figures conflict across sources.

games.title: Half-Life 2
games.notes: Co-op mod with its own custom maps and lives system, also able to run HL2 content. An old Steam thread says it is no longer maintained and not guaranteed to work.

games.title: Half-Life 2
games.notes: Lets TF2 mercenary classes play Half-Life 2 and other Source campaigns in co-op. Search results showed the Steam page as Coming soon, so release status is unverified.

games.title: Doom 3
games.notes: Open source (GPL-3.0) co-op for the dhewm3 port covering Doom 3 and Resurrection of Evil. Repo has 391 commits and 40 open issues, no tagged releases on GitHub.

games.title: Doom 3
games.notes: Older co-op mod for up to 4 players over LAN or internet, covering the base campaign, Resurrection of Evil and 42 custom maps. A Steam guide explains running it with fs_game launch options.

games.title: Quake 4
games.notes: Lets up to four players take on the single-player campaign with synchronised monsters. The ModDB listing calls it a tech demo from 2007; a newer Quake 4 COOP project is described as very unstable.

games.title: Quake
games.notes: Tunes Quake 1's built-in co-op rules: health regeneration, growing respawn delays, one pickup per weapon or key. Works on vanilla maps. Source is on GitHub, last pushed 2021-06.

games.title: Quake II
games.notes: Community mod for co-op on a persistent world server, up to four players per instance. Only a Co-Optimus news item was found, so status is unconfirmed.

games.title: Hexen: Beyond Heretic
games.project: HexenCoop script and Zandronum Hexen coop patch
games.notes: GZDoom script that makes Hexen co-op friendlier (last push 2025-01). A decade-old Zandronum forum patch also exists and its author called it likely glitchy.

games.title: Duke Nukem 3D
games.notes: EDuke32-based mod adding 2-4 player local split-screen co-op with co-op save and load. EDuke32 itself documents working network dukematch and coop. Needs your own DUKE3D.GRP.

games.title: F.E.A.R.
games.notes: v1.0 lets you play the whole base-game single-player campaign in co-op, listed as up to 16 players. Needs the latest patch and a unique CD key per player. A reviewer reports missing music and radio chatter in some levels and no expansions.

games.title: F.E.A.R.
games.notes: Server-side multiplayer fixes that include a Coop mode for F.E.A.R. Platinum or Ultimate Shooter Edition. Last push 2026-01.

games.title: BioShock Remastered
games.notes: Two-player co-op for the full campaign, v0.1 alpha (Nexus upload 2026-10-09, author NykoVoidCrownStudios). The author says the whole campaign has been played start to finish in co-op. The partner has a real in-world character (a Splicer model) and a location marker. The host controls enemy state; both players fight the same enemies and Big Daddies, with occasional desyncs. Doors, switches, hacking and quest items are shared; Little Sister choices and ADAM are per player; elevators are individual, and Hephaestus, Olympus Heights and Proving Grounds objectives are partly per player. The Fontaine boss fight is individual, cutscenes are not fully supported, and the client can crash in Little Sister sequences. Connects by direct IP on UDP 27015 (LAN, port forwarding or a virtual LAN such as Hamachi or Radmin). Both players need the same mod version, Steam BioShock Remastered and no other file mods. Closed source, no repository. Base game is 2007, remaster 2016.

games.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl
games.notes: Addon for the X-Ray Multiplayer Extension launcher, up to 4 players, and described as standalone. A Steam post said it was playable to Yantar; the v8.0 build is dated 2026-08-24 per its distribution package. Servers check addon files, so all players need identical copies.

games.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl
games.notes: Unofficial fix patch on top of Shadow of COOP 8.0 (an extra .db appended to coop.addon). Fixes crashes and stuck quests and unlocks the true ending. All 18 levels boot-tested on a dedicated server and an in-engine self-test passes 20 of 20; no scripted full story run or automated two-client run yet. Tools MIT; patched files remain Shadow of COOP / GSC files.

games.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky
games.notes: xrMPE add-on with a reworked Clear Sky storyline for 1 to 4 players by vladvexa188, first released 2023-11-26. Version 0.5 appeared in March 2024, and one forum post says development was closed.

games.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Pripyat
games.notes: Free co-op extension for Call of Pripyat; listing last updated 2025-12-11. Coverage describes wave-style PvE and a 4-player co-op that includes story and side tasks, but a 2024 Steam post said only TDM and Defense modes worked, so scope claims conflict.

games.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Pripyat
games.notes: Co-op project whose ModDB page says development is delayed by a move to Unreal Engine.

games.title: Gothic / Gothic II
games.notes: AGPL-3.0 Union plugin for co-op in Gothic 1 and Gothic II: Night of the Raven, continuing Colder's earlier GitLab project. Direct IP with VPN tools like Radmin often needed. Last push 2026-02.

games.title: Gothic II: Night of the Raven
games.notes: Server-based multiplayer mod, used by community RPG servers such as Gothic Online: Untold Chapters. It is a persistent online world rather than a shared single-player campaign, and the repo warns the dev version may be unstable. MIT licensed, last push 2026-01.

games.title: Gothic 3
games.notes: Sative Update3, released 2016-03-25, requires CP 1.75.14. The author lists inventory loss and unsynchronised enemy combat. The forum index shows an author reply in 2024-04, so abandonment is unconfirmed. Source, reuse license and exact supported binary hashes remain unverified; the download requires Nexus login.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind
games.notes: Multiplayer for OpenMW, GPL-3.0. Release 0.8.1 (and a VR build) from 2022-05; repo last pushed 2024-05. Servers are community run and scripted in Lua, so co-op rules depend on the server.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion
games.notes: OBSE-based multiplayer with player and mob sync; a 2008 beta announcement cites up to 12 players. A forum post calls all Oblivion multiplayer mods dead.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion
games.notes: 2025 revival. Version 2.1 only demonstrates login and registration with no sync; character sync is planned for 2.2. Needs patch 1.2.0416 and OBSE.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion
games.notes: Beta 0.92 from 2011 for two characters on one PC and one screen, Baldur's Gate style. Needs OBSE 20 or newer. Not networked.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion
games.notes: Old alpha multiplayer mod with limited capabilities per its own page. No date was available.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
games.notes: Released July 2022 for Skyrim SE 1.6 only, then open sourced; core team stepped back to other projects. Console, Game Pass and VR are not supported.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
games.notes: Multiplayer framework that currently supports Skyrim Special Edition. 1,186 stars, last push 2026-10-15.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
games.notes: Multiplayer mod and TypeScript SDK for Skyrim SE, last push 2026-10-11. Server-scripted rather than a drop-in story co-op.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall
games.notes: Continues Tanguy's DFU multiplayer, based on DFU 0.14.5 code, so it may clash with mods. MIT licensed, last push 2025-07.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall
games.notes: Custom Daggerfall Unity build with time and weather sync and synced loot. Last pushed 2023-01, with the sixthlaw fork carrying it on.

games.title: Fallout
games.notes: Two-player co-op on Fallout Community Edition over LAN, internet or one PC, each with their own character. Online server list needs a separate co-op server. Release 1.5.9 seen, last push 2026-10-16.

games.title: Fallout
games.notes: Host plays normally and the second player joins as a human-controlled companion. Author calls it early and rough; v0.6 adds combat sync, known VPN issues and no companion combat perks.

games.title: Fallout 2
games.notes: Dedicated server plus network-viewer client on Fallout 2 CE with per-player characters, shared combat, dialog and barter; host drives map and dialog transitions. README says it is AI-assisted and combat sync is a known soft spot. Release v0.4, 2026-08.

games.title: Fallout 3
games.notes: Multiplayer mod for the PC game; README says it is no longer maintained and the repo was archived 2023-04. Last commit 2021-06 per the GitHub API. Successor effort is NV:MP for New Vegas.

games.title: Fallout: New Vegas
games.notes: Closed-netcode co-op (ENet, UDP 27015): players, NPC motion and combat. Client 9.4 released 2026-10-09; the client and server binaries are closed, the launcher and a server SDK mirror are public. Quests are not synced: the 2016 announcement says each player keeps their own quest log, and the 9.4 binaries localise quest-flagged actors, so quest state, objectives and dialogue results stay per-player. VATS is unavailable in multiplayer. A private session needs no Discord account (only the official ATK server does). Host with the launcher and have friends "Connect via IP", on LAN, over a VPN or with 27015 forwarded.

games.title: Fallout: New Vegas
games.notes: Developer preview of a story layer (xNVSE plugin plus game-free sync core) meant to run next to NV:MP: the host captures the effects of a quest script as one transaction and the clients apply it without re-running the script. No player release yet, but the installer, launcher and player guide are in the tree; the host listens on UDP 27960 and the launcher caps the party at 4. The installer accepts the Russian/PCR Steam release (appid 22490, folder "Fallout New Vegas enplczru") as well as the English one, both at exe 1.4.0.525. Enemy sync in the real game is claimed by another contributor; the avatar, combat, loot and world layers are written but untested in game. MIT licensed.

games.title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines
games.notes: Restores the game's lost multiplayer. Needs Unofficial Patch Plus 11.4 with the Plus Patch option on, host IP shared directly, and the author warns of engine instability. A Steam user reports basic co-op through the Unofficial Patch where many maps crash.

games.title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Redemption
games.notes: Overhaul v1.0 that makes the whole single-player campaign playable in co-op via the multiplayer chronicle list. WON.net is gone so players use VPN or relay tools; files were hosted at e-mods.net, so check links.

games.title: Dark Messiah of Might and Magic
games.notes: Final mod files, not buildable code, 39 stars, last push 2026-03. Needs the wiltOS Mod Launcher and Advanced SDK; a community master server proxies connections. Press says Ubisoft and Valve blessed a Community Edition, and an early test build lacked player models, revive polish and cutscenes. On Linux, A2-03.23 loads and reaches the co-op menu under Proton Experimental (2026-10-23); see games/dark-messiah-of-might-and-magic.

games.title: Far Cry
games.notes: Campaign Coop in v3.0 (2011) packs about 7 of the single-player maps with randomised AI. Players report unfinished missions and missing cutscenes, and version requirements conflict (1.1 vs 1.40).

games.title: Far Cry
games.notes: Global patch and fix mod in alpha, version 1304.98 from 2026-04-26. Co-op is not released; a developer comment says it is being worked on and likely comes in 2026.

games.title: Far Cry
games.notes: Stock campaign maps as a listen or dedicated server; Lua mod pak plus an ASI that hooks CryGame.dll 1.4 (snapshot budget, area triggers for remote players). Also written, but untested in game (joining through a Steam Spacewar relay, the launcher lobby and player shirt colors). 0.2 beta, 2 players checked by hand. Host saves (autosave at checkpoints, save and load commands) keep players and dead enemies, not mission progress; a difficulty setting. A sweep of the 20 levels found 18 that load; Treehouse and Swamp crashed at the load and load now with a workaround (baked physics states are skipped). Helicopters follow once they move on the host; no cutscenes for clients. MIT license. Write-up in games/far-cry.

games.title: Crysis
games.notes: Full single-player campaign co-op, later with Warhead support; the 2019 rewrite moved to Steam master-server connections instead of direct IP or VPN. First release 2016 as a proof of concept; revive via defibrillator, restart if all die. Warhead depended on Crytek approval.

games.title: Crysis
games.notes: A separate, brand-new C++/Lua mod for 2-4 players, internet play via join codes with hole punching or relay, release v0.11.35 on 2026-10-15. Host runs the full single-player simulation; includes a bot or AI-agent companion. README calls Crysis 1 co-op-less, so it is not the older Crysis Co-op mod.

games.title: Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne
games.notes: Planned co-op and versus on an Unreal Tournament base. ModDB page says development ceased and it was archived; commenters say online play with Max Payne 2 is not possible and call it fake.

games.title: Mafia: The City of Lost Heaven
games.notes: Free-roam online multiplayer with Squirrel-scripted game modes, listed version updated 2015-10-06. This is not a shared story campaign. A separate MMP community dates from 2008.

games.title: Mafia II
games.notes: Free-roam multiplayer with dedicated servers and custom game modes, up to 1000 players claimed. Not story co-op, and commenters suggest some servers are inactive.

games.title: Mafia II
games.notes: Open-source (Apache-2.0) rewrite of Mafia 2 Online, repo archived, last push 2018-11, and its own page says it is not ready for players.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
games.notes: The most complete story co-op attempt for San Andreas (GPL-3.0, 600+ stars, in active development). Syncs players, weapons and every shot, vehicles with tuning, explosions, separate peds, EnEx and mission markers; NPC sync and side missions are still in progress. Started through its own launcher, which runs gta_sa.exe with the mod DLL injected, plus a server.exe.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
games.notes: Pre-alpha by the VCCoop authors. Currently two to four players see each other in the same city; no vehicles, shared missions, combat or co-op menu yet. Last push 2026-10.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
games.notes: Host plays as CJ, friends join through a server browser, and mission peds, vehicles, characters and subtitles are mirrored. Networking has automated tests, but the in-game part had not yet been run inside GTA SA when the README was seen. The repo returned not found on API lookup, so check it still exists.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
games.project: Player 2 - Drop In, Drop Out (CLEO) and 2 Player Missions Loader
games.notes: Local second-player scripts: Player 2 can join storyline, vigilante and firefighter missions, and another loader restores 16 cut PS2 missions. Needs CLEO and a second controller; may only work on v1.0.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
games.notes: Server-based multiplayer where players explore and play minigames or roleplay. Search results do not show shared story-mission play, so this does not count as campaign co-op.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto IV
games.notes: v0.3 script-hook mod playing missions online and offline with friends. Mission intros do not work in multiplayer and clients see no cutscenes, blips or text. Thread is about 13 years old.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto IV
games.notes: Server-based multiplayer mods; IV-Network last pushed 2016-10 and the IV:MP repo 2012-12. They offer custom modes, not shared story. Official GTA IV co-op is scenario-based and has no story.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City
games.notes: Free-roam multiplayer, version 0.4 with a 0.4.7.1 client listed November 2025, up to 100 players and Squirrel-scripted servers. Not story co-op.

games.title: Dungeon Keeper
games.notes: Upstream KeeperFX (GPL-2.0, release v1.4.0 on 2026-07-04) is merging a UserState refactor that separates users from players, the groundwork for several users controlling one keeper. PRs 5178, 5229, 5248 and 5428 merged between 2026-09-06 and 2026-10-13; no finished co-op mode was seen.

games.title: Dungeon Keeper
games.notes: Several players control one keeper on KeeperFX with a shared campaign, partner hands shown in each player's colour, and Steam lobby networking (AppID 480) or direct IP. Tested by an in-game bot with real game clients.

games.title: Dungeon Keeper 2
games.notes: Two players share one Keeper faction with equal control of rooms, creatures and gold; the page labels the main campaign fully playable in co-op. Fork of DiaLight's Flame, 103 commits, no licence file found, last push 2026-10-02. Needs DK2 v1.70, UDP 7575, progress saved on the host only.

games.title: Serious Sam: The Second Encounter
games.notes: Steam lists single-player plus co-op for up to 16 players, with 4-player local split-screen. First Encounter has the same on PC per Co-Optimus.

games.title: Serious Sam: The Second Encounter
games.notes: GPL-2.0 mod for classic v1.07 adding multiplayer options including coop support for singleplayer maps. Repo archived, last push 2024-06.

games.title: Unreal
games.notes: Masterkent's 2022 revised Return to Na Pali pack for Unreal Gold 227i/j, 27 maps, single-player and Coop; the map after RTNPUER-Nalic2 is not playable in coop. Search - Prelude is a separate fully coopable campaign.

games.title: Unreal
games.notes: Vanilla-style Coop game type for Unreal Gold with a reworked HUD, scoreboard and map voting; also works in single-player.

games.title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Chaos Theory
games.notes: The game ships a two-player co-op campaign, but Ubisoft's servers are gone so PC players use virtual LAN tools. EnhancedSC is an MIT project (588 stars, active 2026-10) that one forum user says is a portable build of the co-op mode; a small co-op quick-load tool also exists.

games.title: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
games.notes: GPL-3.0 engine reimplementation for KotOR and TSL. A GameStar article described a multiplayer demo with two human-controlled party members, aiming at three-player co-op; only basic gameplay worked in v0.5.1. Repo says mid-stage, last push 2025-04.

games.title: Arx Fatalis
games.notes: Two-player co-op on Arx Libertatis with shared quests and proximity voice chat; marked early work in progress, release 0.22, GPL-3.0. Author says it has never been properly tested over the internet. Last push 2026-09-29.

games.title: Arx Fatalis
games.notes: 2 to 4 player co-op fork of Arx Libertatis with English and French support, HD and classic builds (all players need the same version). Designed for LAN or VPN and never tested over real internet latency. GPL-3.0, last push 2026-09-24.

games.title: Dragon Age: Origins
games.notes: Work in progress on DAOLib, a GPLv3 SKSE-style native plugin framework with an address library for the GOG/EA/Steam builds of 1.05.13263.0. Verified in the game: a guest joins over the network by save transfer, two players control two different party members in the same world mirroring each other, the guest's attack orders are validated and resolved in the host's game, a fallen player's party is revived after the fight, the guest rejoins when the host loads another save, and a plugin-owned SWF HUD screen shows the session event log (filters, creature names). Missing: animation, effect and loot sync, area transitions, a host/join menu and an internet transport; LAN only. Automated two-client tests (sync, join, two avatars, combat, arbitration, death, rejoin, UI) and a 0.7.4 install package with an install script are in the project repo.

games.title: Silent Hill
games.notes: Unofficial PC multiplayer for Silent Hill 1 with an in-game online lobby, Harry and Lisa roles and a live partner map. The repo hosts releases only, source is not public. Last push 2026-09-03; you supply your own game image.

games.title: Resident Evil 4 (2005)
games.notes: Host and join menus, online server browser and LAN for the Ultimate HD Edition. Online play uses Epic Online Services and needs 64-bit Windows 10 or 11; everyone must use the same full release. Author labels it version 1.

games.title: Resident Evil 4 (2005)
games.notes: RE4MP (MIT) was last pushed 2024-04 and remp (coop mod for the UHD version) 2025-07; neither readme was reviewed. Older reports mention a 2018 co-op mod, but a low-quality source claims it added Luis as partner.

games.title: Mount & Blade: Warband
games.notes: One player runs the single-player campaign and each battle is hosted as a multiplayer fight friends can join, with results imported back. Does not share the campaign map or economy; the page lists game version 1.174 and ports 7240-7241. Floris Evolved bundles it.

games.title: Diablo
games.notes: Source port with multiplayer, ZeroTier support since 1.3.0 so no port forwarding, and public game search. Release 1.5.5 on 2025-10-30, repo pushed 2026-10-15. Needs original game data.

games.title: Baldur's Gate
games.notes: A Co-Optimus review describes PC EE co-op with a host and up to six players over TCP/IP; a separate news item says consoles are single-player and one listing says the EEs have no co-op, so sources conflict. Treat as unconfirmed for current builds.

games.title: Neverwinter Nights
games.notes: Steam lists online co-op and says the multiplayer system was rebuilt; persistent worlds also run on it.

games.title: Star Wars Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast
games.notes: GPL-2.0 single-player campaign co-op on OpenJK, shipped as patches 0001-0031 on a pinned OpenJK commit plus a Go installer/launcher (Linux and Windows). The host runs the campaign; joiners run the game code as "dual-load" remote clients over UDP or LAN discovery. Its README lists objectives/cutscene sync for joiners (Track F) as in progress. Continued in masonan777/Jedi-Outcast-Coop; write-up in games/jedi-outcast.

games.title: Star Wars Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast
games.notes: Continues Benehiko's mod with one cumulative patch (0032). Level scripts, enemies, Force powers and the lightsaber now work for joiners, plus a revive system, in-game CO-OP menus, same-PC split screen with two controllers (second window started by the game), LAN and direct IP. A level-crawl bot loaded all 26 campaign maps with a joiner in one run (RESULT PASS 26/26). Tested with 2 players on one PC; two PCs and 3-4 players untested. GPL-2.0. Write-up in games/jedi-outcast.

games.title: Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy
games.notes: GPL-2.0 single-player campaign co-op on OpenJK, 2 to 16 players per current listings (the GitHub readme header still says 2 to 4). Each player keeps their own character and force powers; releases on GitHub, Nexus and JKHub. The main repo koevetmc/JACoop returned not found. Jedi Outcast co-op on OpenJK with the same dual-load design exists (jedi-outcast-coop, see that game).

games.title: Star Wars Republic Commando
games.notes: Two community projects. The ModDB mod reportedly breaks squad commands if a second player joins before a story point; GuestCoop on Nexus is an experimental two-player LAN prototype with animation and desync issues and needs SWRCFix.

games.title: SWAT 4
games.notes: The single-player campaign with AI teammates replaced by humans; The Stetchkov Syndicate (2006) raises it to up to 10 players with red and blue elements and custom-mission servers. Player caps differ between sources.

games.title: No One Lives Forever 2: A Spy in H.A.R.M.'s Way
games.notes: Coop Mod v18072016 (about 21 KB) makes single-player levels playable in co-op; respawning can leave players stuck in one chapter so reviving is advised. The Multiplayer Package v1.3 restores online play after the GameSpy shutdown but is not co-op specific.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
games.notes: Launch coverage says the full campaign is playable with up to 8 players. Nexus changelog shows v1.8.2 fixing NPC name and outfit desync, with support for Skyrim 1.6.1170 and 1.7.104.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
games.notes: Server-authoritative roleplay platform with TypeScript and Papyrus scripting, not a campaign co-op mod. Forks must disclose source; the Discord had about 13k members at listing time.

games.title: Fallout 4
games.notes: A May 2024 developer post (via Reddit mirrors) says it was never finished and was open sourced hoping others would take over. Work lives on the fallout branch of TiltedEvolution, waiting for Skyrim Together Reborn systems to be ported; revival candidate.

games.title: Fallout 4
games.notes: The project page says Fallout 4 Multiplayer has been archived. Guides describe it as no longer working with current game versions.

games.title: Starfield
games.notes: Cosideci reportedly ported about 70 percent of Skyrim Together code then cancelled; coverage says the code was released for others to finish. I could not find a public repository, so the seed claim that code is on GitHub is unconfirmed.

games.title: Starfield
games.notes: Two-player co-op via SFSE plugin plus relay and lobby backend, GPL-3.0, no longer maintained and open for takeover. Targets Starfield 1.16.244 on Steam; official lobby funded until end of 2026. Strong revival candidate.

games.title: Starfield
games.notes: Self-described Starfield multiplayer mod in development; I found no detail on features or releases.

games.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
games.notes: Syncs player movement, combat and appearance, emotes, chat, Gwent duels, trading, horse and boat passengers; a party syncs time, weather and dialog choices. Quests, NPCs and enemies are not synced, so players cannot fight together; the author says enemies will never be added, while the README lists NPC sync as in progress. Requires game 4.04 per its wiki. The public build (GitHub 4755ee7, 2026-08) does not run on Remastered 5.0/5.01 (Sep/Oct 2026); its full gwintManager.ws/gwintGameMenu.ws overrides declare 4.04 Gwent natives that 5.01 removed (static check, see games/witcher-3). Its WitcherNativeBridge helper (MIT) got a 5.01 update on 2026-10-08. Official server or a self-hosted Java server (UDP 40000, port forwarding). Client source GPL-3.0.

games.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
games.notes: Port of Witcher Online to Remastered 5.01 (Steam). Client reads script strings as UTF-8, scripts moved to the 5.x API, Custom Player Characters and Chill Out replaced by stand-ins, Gwent duels off. w3relay carries the traffic over Steam (Spacewar, friends-only lobby), so nobody forwards ports. games.title: Sifu
games.notes: Two-player co-op through a dsound.dll proxy next to Sifu-Win64-Shipping.exe, MIT licensed. Player pose, attacks, health, guard and knockdown sync, as do enemy position, health, guard, death and hit reactions, and a level change pulls the joiner along. Each machine simulates part of the enemies, the host owns enemy health and death, and the joiner reports hits as running totals so lost or duplicated packets are harmless; packets carry a truncated HMAC-SHA256 signature. Shrines, upgrades, age, death counter and saves stay separate, the partner weapon is reported but not equipped, dodge, guard and parry do not travel as reliable events, and bosses and cutscenes are untested. Transport is UDP 7777 over Tailscale, LAN, VPN, a forwarded port or hole punching. The address table is per executable (builds/steam.json and builds/epic.json), and the mod checks the exe build fingerprint and refuses to run on a build it has never seen, so both players need the same game version. games.notes: README says it synchronizes all entities and every level so players share one world, with a Lua modding API; latest release v1.5.1 on 2026-06-01 with 81 open issues and 45 open PRs at check time. License not shown in the captured README.

games.notes: Fork of flyngmt/ACGC-PC-Port with host/client and dedicated-server multiplayer on the multiplayer branch; recent commits sync wildlife, museum letters, Able Sisters trades, house upgrades and PvP tool hits. README calls it a beta that can desync and damage saves; USA Rev 0 disc only, Windows launcher, release 0.2.1 per commit log.

games.notes: README separates what was played (two players, puppets, shared notes, jiggies and flags) from what is only tested off-game (enemies, bosses, revive, party modes). No release was published at check time.

games.notes: Shared collectibles, synced enemies and NPC locking, with lobby via CoopNet (no port forwarding) or direct IP; the world coverage table in the README ranges from 95 percent in Treasure Trove Cove to 50 percent in Bubblegloop Swamp.

games.title: Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts
games.notes: Runs the game's own Xbox LIVE style races and sports over Steam, and adds a Showdown Town single-player co-op mode where players see each other's vehicles and build together. Player count for the co-op mode is not stated.

games.engine: GameCube in Dolphin with Better Sunshine Engine
games.notes: Press coverage says movement, animations, FLUDD, Yoshi, shines and blue coins sync and late joiners are caught up; a dedicated server relays state and a launcher bridges Dolphin memory. GPL-3.0.

games.notes: Shares positions and skeletal poses over TCP so each player sees the other's Link; room transitions are not handled yet and only Outset Island is heavily tested.

games.notes: Room owner picks what is shared, including story progress, the Nintendo Gallery and a delivery bag of quest items; you see up to three other players as animated Links. README labels it early development and requires matching versions.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
games.notes: Online co-op mod for Dusklight where one player hosts, others join by room code (a small server brokers codes, Tailscale or direct address also work), and joining loads the host's save after backing up yours. Seed called it Dusk; the actively developed reimplementation is Dusklight.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
games.notes: Expansion of Crests of Courage with two multiplayer modes, started so the author could play with their kids; everyone must run the same mod version.

games.notes: Repo description says native co-op for Dusklight, work in progress; the README is still the stock Dusklight text so nothing about scope is documented.

games.engine: N64 decompilation port (PD2 fork on port-net)
games.notes: Description claims server-authoritative multiplayer with a dynamic mod loader, hosting either in the client or via a PerfectDarkServer; the README does not say whether campaign co-op is networked.

games.notes: Expanded 1 to 4 player campaign co-op with shared mission items, objectives and Perfect Dark style AI simulants; the README does not describe networking, so assume local play.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
games.engine: SNES in custom bsnes build (bsnes-as with AngelScript)
games.notes: Shows other players' sprites and optionally shares items and some world state, with a Race Mode that disables syncing; group lobbies on the default alttp.online server or a self-hosted one. A community guide says the same client can host Super Metroid.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
games.notes: Author claims synchronized enemies, items and other shared elements over LAN; README suggests Radmin VPN or Hamachi for remote play. One star and only author claims at check time.

games.notes: Lua script that shares health, ammo and inventory; README has per-game modes for A Link to the Past (shared death, split keys, raid bosses with shared HP) and Metroid Zero Mission (items split between players). LGPL-3.0.

games.title: Jak 3
games.notes: Host picks Free roam or Co-op; guests load the host's world, enemies, pickups and mission completion are shared, and co-op keeps guests near the host. Distributed through the OpenGOAL launcher per the README; ISC license.

games.notes: French-language online world mod with a companion exe for network, profile, shop and anti-cheat; the same author has separate Jak 2 and Jak 3 co-op repos. Details are thin.

games.notes: Each player is Sora in their own game; the host owns rooms and enemies and the guest's enemies copy the host's. Author says it was played on two PCs via Steam and Radmin VPN, but many worlds are reached by loading a co-op save, not by playing the story through.

games.title: Pokemon Red/Blue (Gen 1 Recomp)

games.notes: Same-screen local 2 player co-op with a start menu toggle and hotkey Stadium style PvP battles on one keyboard; README warns it is early work in progress.

games.notes: Adds a menu, split screen and netplay to SADX; a large number of objects and systems were adapted per the README. Scope of what is synced online is in the repo docs, which were not read.

games.notes: Chao-focused: visit friends' gardens, race and fight in karate; others only receive copies of your Chao data. Optional dedicated server via Docker or Windows exe; MIT.

games.notes: ModLoader64 plugin (GPL-3.0) whose README has only a title; nothing about scope or status could be confirmed.

games.notes: README says moons are shared, captures and costumes sync, and custom game modes are supported, but calls the mod early in development. Community-run servers; MIT.

games.notes: Online and local multiplayer for Jak 1 on the OpenGOAL PC port, installed from the OpenGOAL launcher's Mods menu.

games.notes: Native PC recompilation for Windows and Linux with two-player co-op through X's or Zero's campaign, local or netplay (recomp-net), unified or experimental split camera. Player 1 owns story progress. MIT.
